headline: IEA Warns of Extreme Supply Concentration in Global Clean Energy Equipment
summary: International Energy Agency Executive Director Fatih Birol warned that global clean energy transition supply chains remain dangerously concentrated. China currently dominates global manufacturing capacity for solar equipment, wind turbines, and batteries.
why: Concentration of critical clean energy manufacturing in single markets poses supply disruptions and geopolitical risks for global decarbonization.

impacts.name: Clean Technology
impacts.why: Heavy reliance on concentrated foreign supply chains creates trade and operational risks.
